question: On the eve of the 73rd Republic Day, Neeraj Chopra was awarded which of the following medals by the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Param Vishisht Seva Medal **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Param Vishisht Seva** Medal is an **Indian military honour.**
 
• It was established in 1960 and has been presented in appreciation of exemplary peacetime service ever since. It may be bestowed posthumously.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra, **the first Indian track and field athlete to win an **Olympic gold medal** and a member of the Indian Army's 4 Rajputana Rifles, has been given the **Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM) for his exceptional service.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vishisht Seva Medal **is an Indian military medal. It is given to all ranks of the Indian Armed Forces to commemorate "distinguished service of a high order." The prize might be given posthumously.
 
• The** Sena Medal is given to Indian army troops of all grades **"for such individual acts of outstanding dedication to duty or heroism as having unique importance for the Army." Posthumous awards are possible.
 
• The** Ati Vishisht Seva Medal **is an Indian military decoration granted to all ranks of the armed forces to honour "distinguished service of an extraordinary kind." The award is the peacetime counterpart of the** Wartime Distinguished Service medal Uttam Yuddh Seva** Medal.
